entities.summary: Prachi Garg; born 19 May 1984) is an Indian author columnist, academic speaker, traveler and entrepreneur. Her books "Superwomen", focused on women entrepreneurship and "Supercouples" based on the entrepreneurship endeavors and challenges by couples. Much of her subject or theme is oriented towards entrepreneurship, social issues and development and women empowerment in the context of Indian subcontinent. She combines dreams with realism with facts derived from the practical life.
